_source: Additions the club asked for on articles stored in the database, which cannot be written from a developer machine. Applied at build time, in order: `wrap` turns the first mention of some words into a link to `href`; `text` is placed after the paragraph that ends with `after` (or at the end when that is missing or empty).
_rule: An addition is skipped when the article already contains its `unless` string, so pasting the same thing into the article in Control panel -> News retires it here with no duplicate. The stored text itself is never changed.

additions.text: !![Ade Owolana in League Eight’s first two matches, 6 and 13 September 2026](/assets/articles/ade-owolana-first-two-matches.jpg#1200x750)
Read [Ade Owolana’s player profile](/players/ade-owolana.html) for every appearance, goal and award.

Both clubs told the story of the match on Instagram. Three Little Birds led 2–0 at half-time and scored twice more at the start of the second half to go 4–0 up. TSM then had a man sent off after 50 minutes.

Down to ten men, TSM scored three times and finished the match pushing for an equaliser. Three Little Birds called it a nervy finish; TSM said they almost completed the comeback but ran out of time.

Three Little Birds’ graphic names Victor as the scorer of a hat-trick and their Man of the Match, with TJ also among their scorers. TSM wore their new green home kit for the first time.

Both clubs sent their best wishes to a Three Little Birds midfielder who was injured during the match.
